title: Tidepool Upload Duplication
body:
I usethe xDrip+ upload to Tidepool.
I now have a a t:slim x2 pump & upload from it.
The only problem is that data gets duplicated - carbs & boluses.
I want to upload CGM data & notes from xDrip, especially as the x2 is not yet integrated with the Dexcom G6.
Would it be possible to choose whether to upload carbs & boluses?

comments.body: I have a similar problem (using Medtronic's 723), except only boluses seem to be duplicated. The only reason I manually upload  the pump to Tidepool at all is because xDrip doesn't upload basal data but, when I upload from the pump, my bolus amounts are duplicated and this makes my reported daily insulin doses way more than it is. I'd like to be able to select what information is uploaded to Tidepool as well if it's at all possible.

Same problem with manual uploading from the PDM (Omnipod). I guess we need a flag to choose treatments upload for those of us who use xDrip+ to log them. Either this or get it done directly from Nightscout the same way Dexcom is integrated with Dex Share.
It's been fixed. This is a duplicate. You can now select to upload only BG if you upload pump treatments manually.
We can reopen if/when more data is provided.
